items.title: Live: Ceasefire on brink after Israel pounds Lebanon with wave of strikes
items.description: Benjamin Netanyahu said Lebanon was not included in the truce, while Iran accused Israel of ceasefire breaches and barred ships from crossing the Strait of Hormuz. Follow live.

items.title: With Israel's 'finger on the trigger', can the truce last? Matthew Doran has what you need to know
items.description: Iran thinks Lebanon was part of this truce. The US and Israel did not. That split could shatter the fragile peace, which could benefit the Israeli PM.

items.title: Iran and US already at odds over ceasefire terms
items.description: Israeli strikes on Lebanon threaten to scuttle the US-Iran ceasefire as Iranian state media reports the Strait of Hormuz has been closed.

items.title: As Trump's rhetoric escalates, Albanese diplomatically eyes off-ramp
items.description: Neither side of politics in Australia rushed to celebrate the temporary ceasefire that followed US President Donald Trump's threat with too much enthusiasm.

items.title: How long will it take petrol prices to get back to pre-Iran war levels, if at all?
items.description: Iran's promise to reopen the Strait of Hormuz after striking a temporary agreement with the US saw the cost of oil fall sharply. But how quickly are we likely to see relief at the bowser in Australia? Analysts say it could be weeks or months.

items.title: Singapore's PM knows Australia is vulnerable but Albanese has leverage
items.description: Anthony Albanese is flying to Singapore as part of a hastily arranged regional mission to shore up crucial fuel supplies, amid warnings the global energy crisis could "sharply turn for the worse".

items.title: Uni in financial crisis spent nearly $1.5m on leadership coach, documents show
items.description: Documents released to Four Corners show the University of Technology Sydney spent hundreds of thousands of dollars a year on a leadership coach before planning to slash jobs and courses to save money.

items.title: US architect admits killing eight women in Gilgo Beach murders
items.description: Rex Heuermann pleads guilty to seven murders and admits to the killing of another woman, solving a notorious case known as the Gilgo Beach killings.

items.title: 'Ketamine Queen' jailed for 15 years over death of Friends star Matthew Perry
items.description: Jayvee Sangha admits to running a "stash house" that helped supply the famous Friends star ketamine in the months before his death.

items.title: Family still waits to know how their loved one died, one year on
items.description: The family of Indigenous man Kumanjayi White has criticised the secrecy around the independent review into his death, which has been handed to NT Police and the DPP but not released publicly.

items.title: Brisbane suburbs set to become 'mini CBDs' as city prepares for population surge
items.description: As Brisbane prepares for an expected surge in population over the next 15 years, the council has introduced a plan to allow high-rise apartments in some of the city's suburban hubs.

items.title: Mining on the Moon is closer than ever, but challenges remain
items.description: A scientist, an engineer, an archaeologist and a lawyer break down some of the physical, environmental, ethical and legal challenges of mining on the Moon.

items.title: House built on wrong block moved after messy legal battle
items.description: A Victorian couple has been forced to move their home that was accidentally built on the wrong block.

items.title: Top neuroscientist slams AFL move to back new headgear
items.description: The AFL has backed a new helmet that aims to reduce the risk of concussion, but a top neuroscientist is calling it "bad scientific practice".

items.title: A 'bunch of nobodies' changed Australia — now a new generation carries their torch
items.description: When a "bunch of nobodies" in Sydney decided to stand up to police brutality, no-one could guess their impact would still be felt more than 50 years later.

items.title: Failed referendum inspires two top dance companies to join forces
items.description: Sixteen dancers from Bangarra Dance Theatre and 19 ballet dancers from the Australian Ballet have joined forces for Flora, choreographed by Bangarra artistic director Frances Rings.

items.title: Test your knowledge with our classic Australian TV quiz
items.description: One quote, two possible answers: test your knowledge and take a nostalgic trip down memory lane as you match the quote to the iconic Australian television series.

items.title: Writers' Week crisis that unfolded 'hour by hour' revealed in FOI emails
items.description: An extraordinary series of emails sheds light on the reservations that preceded, and internal fallout that followed, the decision to scrap Randa Abdel-Fattah's Writers' Week appearance.

items.title: Egg-laying hens in cages set for better living conditions under new laws
items.description: The lives of caged hens are set to improve as Victoria implements new welfare laws, but farmers say they have not been consulted.

items.title: New initiative urges personal pledges to overcome 'overwhelming' DV stats
items.description: A new platform, dubbed Justice For Her, is centred on making small, actionable pledges to help people overcome the overwhelming statistics on gendered violence, which often lead to inaction.

items.title: 'The whole industry will fall over': Transport leaders call for urgent action
items.description: An emergency Fair Work Commission hearing in Sydney begins, with unions and employers in the transport industry saying drivers, employees and businesses are on the verge of going under, calling on the top of the supply chain to share the load.

items.title: Distance triples and comeback kings end Aus Open swimming
items.description: Sam Williamson capped his comeback with victory in the 50m breaststroke just 11 months after he suffered a career-threatening injury.

items.title: Cyclone Maila moving again towards Far North Qld coast
items.description: Cyclone Maila has woken up and is heading west, with the category four system still likely to reach Queensland's far north on Monday.

items.title: 'Offensive', 'degrading': Court documents reveal Jackie O's complaints
items.description: Court documents allege Jackie "O" Henderson was subject to "offensive and degrading" comments about her personal and dating life from co-host Kyle Sandilands in two separate incidents last year.

items.title: Human bones found on Rottnest Island, investigation underway
items.description: Police are investigating the origin of what are believed to be several human bones that were found on Rottnest Island.
